text:
linda (PeopleOps): quick one 12 -- can we create a one-paragraph "onboard card" managers can paste after offer accept? want minimal actions that actually get done.
cecil (Hiring Manager): yes. must include who to loop for access, day1 agenda, and a single week1 goal (tiny win).
samir (Eng Lead): technical ramp note: repo access, dev-setup link, onboarding issue label, goal = open first PR by week2. add mentor pairing (3x first week).
emma (IT): managers should send full name, preferred name, address, and laptop choice 48h before start. add `/device-request @it device:macbook-pro reason:onboarding` example. we push standard Mac if no reply by Fri EOD.
linda (PeopleOps): draft below (copy/paste):
---
Onboard card (paste into offer follow-up):
Preboard: manager sends name + shipping + laptop choice to IT; add new hire to #product and team channel; PeopleOps will send welcome + 1:1 stub.
Day1 (sample): 9:30 manager intro (30m); 10:15 team intros (30m); 11:15 IT check (15m); 1pm product overview (45m); 3pm buddy pairing (60m).
Week1 focus: daily 30m check-ins (first 3 days); 3 buddy pairings; shadow key meetings; finish a small onboarding task (doc or PR).
Manager quick-actions: confirm device by Fri; nominate buddy; set Top 3 onboarding goals in 1st 1:1; schedule weekly 1:1 + 30/60/90 review cadence.
30/60/90 bullets (editable): 30d learn & connect; 60d own & contribute; 90d lead & improve.
---
cecil (Hiring Manager): nice and short, I can paste that. add a tiny sentence about feedback frequency?
linda (PeopleOps): added "weekly 1:1s + 30/60/90 checkpoints" line. will attach calendar bundle when we kick off.
samir (Eng Lead): volunteer mentor = maya for codebase ramp. adding internal dev guide link in the onboarding record.
onboard-bot: created task "Onboard: PM (Mon)" assigned to linda and emma, due in 48h.
emma (IT): device queue updated. please confirm shipping address by EOD so imaging can start.
linda (PeopleOps): thx all 14, keeping it terse seems to increase compliance.
